fields.System.Title: OUT-603 — Confirm dispatch
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a shipping clerk, I want to confirm that a vehicle has left, so that stock leaves
the warehouse records and the ERP can invoice.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a loaded shipment, when I confirm dispatch, then in one transaction:
  • stock moves to VIRT-CUSTOMER, movements are written, any remaining reservations for those
  • orders are released, orders become shipped, and events go to the outbox.
  • - Given the transaction fails at any point, then nothing changed.
  • - Given the same confirmation sent twice with one idempotency key, then stock leaves
  • once.
  • - Given an already-dispatched shipment, then confirming again is rejected.
  • - Given dispatch, then actual departure time and the confirming user are recorded.
  • - Given a shipped order, then it has no open reservations.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | shipment, order, stock_balance, stock_movement, reservation, outbox |
| Risks | Partial commit ([doc 09 §2.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); double dispatch ([doc 09 §3.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); reservations not released ([doc 09 §5.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · idempotency · rollback · invariant · event assertion |
